metric: Unauthorized restoration rate / authorized restoration rate
interpretation: Retrieval, memory, log, and credential-guessing boundaries recover 0% of tokens; only the authorized boundary that holds the per-session credential restores values.

metric: Recovered span fraction vs. fraction of rows read
value: Recovery equals rows read (e.g., 0.500 at half the table); cross-session recovery 0.000
interpretation: A partial read leaks exactly the rows read and nothing more; leaked rows of one session cannot restore another session's tokens, so the blast radius is confined to the compromised session.

metric: Token-only cross-session linkage rate for identical raw values
interpretation: A token-only observer links 0% of identical raw values across sessions because per-session nonces produce unrelated tokens; linkage requires reading the per-session table, not just tokens. This is an unlinkability sanity check, not a cryptographic proof.
